summary: To keep templates with certain labels out of the portal, add excludeLabels as an array (for example ['test', 'example']) under sync.jobTemplates alongside labels.
questions: How do I exclude job templates from the portal by label?
What is excludeLabels in portal sync?
Keep test templates out of self-service automation portal

answer_card.title: Exclude templates by label
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
          jobTemplates:
            enabled: true
            labels: [portal, self-service, production]
            excludeLabels:
              - "test"
              - "example"
            schedule:
              frequency: { minutes: 60 }
              timeout: { minutes: 15 }
```
`excludeLabels` must be an array.
